_comment: English locale for SpellingBee. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim, and keep the bracket example '[example]' and the allowed-letters display neutral (they are literal game syntax).

_slots.{allowed_letters}: The set of allowed letters, sorted and joined (do not translate)

prompt.intro:
Wena ndi Muthandeni {player_id} mu Nthandeni ya Ulemba.
Maboko ya Vumelano: {allowed_letters}
Kila lilombo limelemba kufikia kulemba kwa lilombo lileta.
Mazwi ya kulemba kwa kawiri hayavumelani.
Fungula lilombo lako mu maboko ya miraba, e.g., '[example]'.

invalid.shorter: Lilombo lilembwa ndi lifupi kuliko lilombo lileta.
invalid.not_a_word: Lilombo lilembwa si lilombo lya Kiingeleza lya vumelano.
invalid.illegal_characters: Lilombo lilembwa lina boko zisizo za vumelano.
invalid.wrong_format: Lilombo lilembwa halilembwi mu ndhindhili ya vumelano. Ndapata kumbuka kutumia maboko ya miraba.
